fieldValues.title: RFC-052: The root container is stored in the container set
fieldValues.author: Peter Brownell (owner ruling 2026-10-20, the-greenman/srs#940 ruling 2; accepted 2026-10-20, the-greenman/srs#941)
fieldValues.affected_components:
The repository manifest (the required inline `container` is replaced by a required `rootContainerId`; the root container is stored in the container set at `containers/<containerId>.json`), RFC-013 [R1] and [R9] (withdrawn), RFC-038 [R1], [R22], Change F and Change K, reading-rule notes in RFC-025, RFC-026, RFC-029, RFC-042 and RFC-043, Invariants I-79 and I-87 (amended, effective at revision 10), the dataModelRevision generation (9 to 10), and a successor record superseding rfc-decision-2fb87c1e's inline-root exception. Landing is two-phase because the data migration lives in the srs-rust migration registry (srs-rust#1417) and the pinned binary cannot load a revision-10 corpus: what lands with acceptance is the RFC text, the Door 3 amendments, the amended invariant and mechanism records (each gated "effective at dataModelRevision 10") and the successor decision record. The schema files (manifest.json, srsj-envelope.json, container.json) are staged under docs/schema/staged/rfc-052/ and are promoted into docs/schema/2.0/ in the corpus-migration step, together with the metamodel generator change and the migrated corpus; the integration manifest therefore names the artifacts folded now and no schema: token. Revision 5 (Door 3, the-greenman/srs#953) amends [R1], [R7] and Change C and adds Change D and [R8] (setting and unsetting the root, and `migration-root-missing`), folded into I-79 and the Manifest mechanism; implementation the-greenman/srs-rust#1453. Revision 6 (Door 3, the-greenman/srs#963) amends Change C, [R7], Change D, [R8] and the error-code table (the restamp of a manifest that already names `rootContainerId`, the meaning of `migration-root-missing`, and `container-not-found` for an unknown id), folded into I-79 and the Manifest mechanism.

fieldValues.dependency_refs: Builds on RFC-013 (required root container, Accepted), RFC-038 (tree-authoritative storage, Accepted) and RFC-043 (ordered container entries, Accepted). Supersedes in part rfc-decision-2fb87c1e (its inline-root exception). Consults rfc-decision-cce3c00e, rfc-decision-9ee14517, rfc-decision-7caca3a1, rfc-decision-e99a9437, rfc-decision-628cf6c4, rfc-decision-4431046e, rfc-decision-86f49083. Precedes RFC-051 (per-entry container storage, revision 11).
fieldValues.content: The manifest stops carrying the root container inline and names it by a required `rootContainerId`; the root container is stored in `containers/` like every other container and keeps every role it has (repository identity, navigation order). The manifest holds no content. Split from RFC-051 as its ruling 2 (owner: "worth the cost as long as this happens soon and is not lost"). Revision 5 (Door 3, owner rulings 2026-10-23, the-greenman/srs#953 and srs-rust#1440): an older corpus is detected by its declared `dataModelRevision` (9 or lower), never by shape; the migration refuses a revision-9 manifest that declares no root (`migration-root-missing`); setting the root is pointer-only (it changes only `rootContainerId`, accepts only an existing container and changes no container; the previous root stays an ordinary container); unsetting the root is refused (`manifest-root-container-missing`), so from revision 10 a repository always has exactly one root. Revision 6 (Door 3, owner answers 2026-10-24, the-greenman/srs#962 and #963): a manifest that declares revision 9 or lower but already names its root by `rootContainerId`, with the root stored, is migrated by restamping `dataModelRevision` to 10 only, after checking the root is stored, is the only root and validates; `migration-root-missing` means neither `container` nor `rootContainerId`; setting the root to an id that names no container is refused with `container-not-found`. Full text: rfcs/rfc-052-root-container-in-container-set.md.
